title: AI Portal
subtitle: List published agents for employees; they only see the name, description and category — never the type of the underlying resource.
actionFailed: The action failed. Please try again.
empty: No portal apps yet. Add a published agent, then list it for employees.
sourceHint: Only published, usable resources are listed; the source cannot be changed once listed.
sourceLocked: A listed app cannot change its source — delist it first.
noSources: Nothing to choose from: publish an agent first.
added: Added — employees see it once it is listed

confirm.listBody: Before listing we check that the source is published, the audience is valid and no capability reference is broken; employees see it right away.
confirm.delistBody: Employees stop seeing it and cannot start new calls at once; history follows the portal settings; configuration and audit records are kept.
confirm.deleteBody: The configuration disappears from the list; the action is audited.

settings.previewSoon: Preview opens once the employee side is live

nav.title: Navigation and discovery

session.title: Conversation abilities

personal.title: Employee personal settings

members.grantTitle: AI portal seats granted by the platform
members.grantNote: Set by the platform per contract; tenant admins cannot change it
members.overContract: Over the contracted {{seats}} seats — in the grace allowance.
members.rulesHint: When on, everyone in the department (and its sub-departments) gets a portal seat; someone recalled inside a department is not re-assigned by the rule.
members.autoAssign: Assign a seat on first sign-in (while seats are available)

analytics.noUsage: No usage in this period yet.
analytics.overActive: {{active}} employees were active this month, above the contracted {{seats}} portal seats (monthly active mode).
analytics.definitions: Definitions: only employee-portal runs (source=portal); active employees = distinct employees who made a call; success rate = succeeded / (succeeded + failed), excluding in-flight and cancelled; rating = up / (up + down), hidden until there are ratings; changes compare with the previous period of equal length; “this month” is the UTC calendar month.
